_why: Moves from a video, from a LINK (A44-8, user 2026-10-19: a YouTube link, Google Drive and other links). The browser cannot read the picture of a video another site plays, so the hub fetches it onto this PC (main_python/hub_video.py) and Studio reads it from the hub. For the user's own use. A new share site is one entry in shares; a new error in words is one entry in say.

shares.label: Google Drive
shares.html: Google Drive did not hand over the video. Open its Share settings, set it to “Anyone with the link”, and try again.

shares.label: Dropbox
shares.html: Dropbox did not hand over the video. Make the link one that anyone can open, and try again.

ytdlp._why: yt-dlp reads YouTube, Facebook, TikTok, Vimeo, Instagram, X and about a thousand other sites. Run as its own program, not imported: MiceHub.exe cannot import a package installed later. The first one that answers --version is used.
ytdlp._why2: YouTube's player needs a JavaScript runtime to solve its challenge (yt-dlp 2025+, checked 2026-10-19): deno is yt-dlp's default, node is added when this PC has it (the face app's page already needs node), and the solver script may be fetched.

say.say: The site is asking this PC to prove it is not a robot. Try again later, or download the video yourself and pick the file.
